Introduction

Walking After U is a South Korean girl band that currently consists of three members: A-Zzang, Haein and Hangyeom. They were formed from the merger of two other bands (Rubber Duckie and Swingz) and made their official debut on September 19, 2014 under LODIS Company.

Sunny's departure from the group was announced via the group's Instagram on June 2, 2024.
